CONSULTING SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Agreement is entered into on this day between the Client and
the Service Provider. Both parties agree to the terms below in the
spirit of a friendly, professional working relationship.

SCOPE OF WORK

The Service Provider will write, edit, and fact-check pages for the
Client's books and website. The total page goal for this engagement
is 180 pages, reviewed in monthly batches.

PAYMENT TERMS

The Client will pay $50 per page, invoiced monthly and payable
within 30 days.

REVISIONS

The Client may request two rounds of revisions per batch, each to be
delivered within 14 days of receiving the drafted pages.

TERMINATION

Either party may end this Agreement with 30 days' written notice.
Work completed through the notice date will be paid in full.
